topic: Data synchronization and frequency calculation updates
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple data tasks, including mirroring information and calculating historical facility data. A specific request was made to use the existing Japan frequency calculation from staging for both Analytics and Campaign modules.

Regarding the frequency logic, someone noted that the current production code had been refactored, making it risky to deploy immediately. Testing of the frequency calculation across significant clients (comparing production vs. staging) is required, with a tentative plan to test in about a week.

Finally, after checking the data, it was confirmed that while there is a difference between campaign impressions and dashboard impressions (visible on both staging and production), this difference is only noticeable when selecting all facilities; for single facilities, the discrepancy is not critical.
decisions: Use existing Japan frequency calculation from staging for Analytics and Campaign modules.
action_items: Calculate historical data for mirrored facilities starting from 2025-02-14.
Test the refactored frequency logic (production vs. staging) with significant clients in about a week.
